legend.jpSafety.accidentsPeriod: NPA 2025 main records (~97% occurred in 2025; ~3% occurred in 2024 or earlier), published 2026-10-01; {total} injury crashes, one point each
legend.jpSafety.accidentsScope: Injury crashes only (fatal = death within 24 h); property-damage-only crashes are not in this file and not covered. Locations are as recorded by police; 3 crashes without coordinates are not mapped.
